tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. A sage-tinted off-white; never pure white for the page.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, form fields, itinerary panel: anything that sits on `surface`.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Warm section band (the old site's sand). Use for one band per page, e.g. "Plan your trip" or the enquiry block. `ink` and `forest` read on it.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: The logo's sage. Fills, rules, timeline dots, decorative blocks. Light theme: never text (2.5:1 on `surface`); put `on-sage` text on a sage fill.

tokens.name: sage-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet sage band and selected/hover fill. `ink`, `ink-muted` and `forest` all read on it.

tokens.name: on-sage
tokens.usage: Text on a `sage` fill (badges, cover blocks). 5.9:1 light, 8:1 dark.

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: Primary actions (Enquire), links, prices and active states. Text colour on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `sand`, `sage-soft` (7.5:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: on-forest
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `forest` fill (primary button). 9.5:1 light, 10:1 dark.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meal plans, captions, "per person" labels. 5.3:1 or more on every surface, both themes.

tokens.name: taupe
tokens.usage: The old site's button taupe, kept as a quiet secondary: outline-button borders and labels, footer text. 5.6:1 on `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders, table rules, form-field borders at rest (decorative; field borders use `ink-muted` on focus).

tokens.name: whatsapp
tokens.usage: WhatsApp button fill only. Always with `on-whatsapp` text and the word "WhatsApp".

tokens.name: on-whatsapp
tokens.usage: Text on `whatsapp` (7.9:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, so it lands on the surface around the control (3:1 or more on every surface).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Home hero headline only. One per page.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Page titles: trip, park and guide pages.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles, itinerary day titles, team names.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Tailor-made safaris led by Tanzanian guides since 2007.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a page title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Rise early for breakfast before departing with a packed lunch for the Serengeti.
styles.usage: All running text. Quicksand at 500, never 300/400 for body.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Meta lines, captions, form hints, footer.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a title (duration, region, section). Set text-transform: uppercase; the only all-caps text on the site.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices, with tabular numerals. Always followed by a `small` "per person" label.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: eyebrow to title, label to field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (mobile), page gutter minimum.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding (desktop), grid gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section padding (mobile).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding (desktop).

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Hero and major band padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, form fields, table cells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and small cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Trip cards, images, the itinerary panel, bands with a rounded inset.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The WhatsApp button and review badges only.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Trip cards on hover and the floating WhatsApp button. Nothing else has a shadow.
